basic_info.description: Welcome to unit 373 at 875 La Playa, a peaceful oceanside community in close proximity to world-famous Golden Gate Park and Ocean Beach. This 1 bed 1 bath unit is meticulously maintained and move-in ready. The open floor plan and a beautifully reimagined kitchen feature an open-concept bar area, modern upgraded cabinets, and quartz countertops. This light-filled retreat includes a well-appointed master suite complete with a terrace overlooking Golden Gate Park and a spa-like bath with upgraded vanity and cabinets. Modern conveniences include in-unit washer/dryer deeded storage and deeded 1-car garage parking.    Building amenities include a gorgeous central courtyard with BBQ grills and seating, bicycle storage room, fitness center, & more. Other local attractions include Cliff House, Sutro Baths, Sutro Heights Park, Andytown Coffee, Lands End, Safeway, public transit, Great Highway, and the soon-to-open Ocean Beach Park. Whether you're into surfing, biking, or walking, recreational opportunities are as unlimited as your imagination!
